summary: Verified the Anthropic model rename fix (claude-sonnet-4-20250514 → claude-sonnet-4-6). Backend side is FULLY FIXED: /api/conjoint/studies/{id}/qualitative-analysis returns 200 with Thai suggested_attributes in ~40-45s, no more litellm NotFoundError. Conjoint AI thesis interpretation and Brand Equity ai-analyze background job also complete cleanly with no model-not-found errors. All 65 regression tests (test_conjoint_audit_2026_08, test_conjoint_final_e2e, test_conjoint_stats_correctness) still pass. HOWEVER, the reported end-user flow is STILL BROKEN through the UI: axios.defaults.timeout is set globally to 30000ms in /app/frontend/src/pages/../App.js:86, but the LLM analysis takes ~40-45s. The frontend request is aborted at 30s → user sees no result even though the backend completed 200. Same latency-vs-timeout mismatch will affect every long Claude call that inherits the global axios default (currently: ConjointQualitativePage handleAnalyze, and any other page that does not pass an explicit timeout override).

rca_of_the_issue: Two-layer bug. LAYER 1 (fixed by developer): Anthropic retired the dated alias claude-sonnet-4-20250514, so every backend with_model('anthropic', 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514') call — 18 sites in server.py + conjoint.py + one stored llm_prompts.model_name — returned litellm NotFoundError. Developer renamed all 18 sites to claude-sonnet-4-6, migrated the Mongo config, and added a defensive guard in analyze_qualitative_data that coerces any saved model starting with 'claude-sonnet-4-2025' back to claude-sonnet-4-6. Verified: 5/5 iter32 API tests pass, 65/65 regression tests pass, backend logs show POST qualitative-analysis → 200 in 40.15s with Thai suggested_attributes. LAYER 2 (still broken, must be fixed before redeploy): /app/frontend/src/App.js sets axios.defaults.timeout = 30000 globally. ConjointQualitativePage.handleAnalyze does not pass an explicit timeout, so the axios call inherits 30s. Since the Claude call takes ~40-45s, the browser aborts before the response arrives; the interceptor logs 'Request timeout: .../qualitative-analysis'; handleAnalyze catches an axios error with no error.response, so error.response?.data?.detail is undefined and the fallback toast 'ไม่สามารถวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลได้' is shown for ~3s then disappears. The user perceives 'nothing happened' or 'analysis failed' even though the backend completed 200. Fix: pass { timeout: 120000 } to the axios.post in ConjointQualitativePage.js handleAnalyze (and audit other Claude-backed synchronous frontend calls for the same latent bug — Brand Equity ai-analyze uses queue+poll and is fine).
